title: Payment Settings (ABA Pay)
subtitle: Manage your ABA Payway merchant profile, KHQR gateway credentials, and automated checkout verification.
telegramBannerTitle: Contact us on Telegram to request ABA Payway for your shop
telegramBannerDesc: Contact us on Telegram to request or set up ABA Payway (KHQR) for your shop — our team will assist you in acquiring your Merchant Profile ID & Secret Key credentials.
configDesc: Each shop uses its own ABA Pay profile (KHQRcc gateway). Enter the Profile ID and Secret Key from KHQRcc Settings. Until a valid Profile ID + Secret Key are saved, customers will NOT see a QR code — the checkout page shows "Online payment unavailable" instead.
profileIdHelp: Provided in your ABA Payway merchant onboarding credentials.
hashFormat: Hash format: sha1(secret + transaction_id + amount + success_url + remark)
sandboxToggleDesc: When enabled, mock payments auto-succeed without debiting real bank accounts or charging customer cards.
testDisabledWarning: Enter Profile ID & Secret Key to enable testing
testSuccess: ABA Payway configuration is valid & connected!
scanWithAnyApp: or any Bakong KHQR banking application
webhookSecurityDesc: ABA Payway webhooks are cryptographically authenticated via SHA-1 HMAC hashing to prevent spoofed transactions.
